lines.zh: 我一只眼悬在半空，慢慢移。
lines.en: One great eye hangs in the air, drifting.

lines.zh: 我的外壳一直转个不休。
lines.en: My casing never stops rotating.
I drift along the horizon, steady.
I rise and fall as if testing.
I circle you half way, then draw back.
I drift, keeping my eye fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方空气发烫。
lines.en: The air scorches where I pass.

lines.zh: 我从云下穿过去，云被撕开。
lines.en: I pass beneath the clouds and tear them.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一段，重新找位置。
lines.en: I withdraw a stretch and reposition.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，忽然又横移。
lines.en: I hang still, then shift sideways.
I hover, my lids never still.
Light gathers behind my pupil.

lines.zh: 我眨一下，周围亮了一瞬。
lines.en: I blink and the area flares.
My casing turns very slowly.
I'm charging, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的视线没有一刻偏移。
lines.en: My gaze never shifts.
I ignore every sound around.

lines.zh: 我把自己悬在一个高度。
lines.en: I hold myself at one altitude.

lines.zh: 我的光映在地上，一团白。
lines.en: My light makes a white pool on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不累，我可以这样待很久。
lines.en: I don't tire. I can hold this a long while.
I'm waiting for you to move.
A thin ring of light rims me.
The wind pushes me and I barely shift.
I draw my light in slowly.
That light is my heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我在算你还有多少路可退。
lines.en: I'm reckoning how much ground you have.
You're dead centre in my sight.
I look down at you without moving.

lines.zh: 激光一亮，影子钉在地上。
lines.en: My laser flares and pins your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的每一步都被我扫过。
lines.en: I've scanned every step you take.
I don't speak. I only watch.
I turn slowly around you.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我眼里很慢。
lines.en: Your weapon looks slow to me.

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我的中心线。
lines.en: You're standing on my centre line.

lines.zh: 我靠近了一点，又退回去。
lines.en: I come closer, then withdraw.
You looked up; just as I wanted.

lines.zh: 你手上有汗，光下看得清。
lines.en: Your hands are sweating. I can see in this light.

lines.zh: 我的一只眼，就够看住你。
lines.en: One eye is enough to hold you.
A seam has opened in the casing.
My radiance dimmed for an instant.
I shear aside and realign.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的视线晃了。
lines.en: That shook my line of sight.
Light leaks from the crack.
The laser eye hovers high.

lines.zh: 疼我不好说，只是我少了一层。
lines.en: Pain's uncertain. I've lost a layer.
I turn slowly back to the front.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩了一下，锁定你了。
lines.en: Pupil contracted, target acquired.
A few more and I'll scatter.
There's light on you. Faint.
That thing catches the light.
I descend slowly, closing in.
I want to see what that is.
Hold it higher and the light scatters.
I stare until my pupil narrows.
That little light — I could take it.
I've shifted off my line.
A little closer and I'll see.
Right. Noted.
You hit my casing. Hard.
I wobble and my light scatters.
I rise back and hold myself still.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔转过来对着你。
lines.en: My pupil swings round to you.
Such contact means nothing.
I climb two blocks.
Your hand grazes my rim.
The bump shifted me a metre.

lines.zh: 我慢慢回到原来的位置。
lines.en: I drift back to where I was.
There needn't be another.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，也只看得见一个。
lines.en: I have one eye, and I see only one.
The other eye is elsewhere.
We two were a pair to begin with.

lines.zh: 我不需要别的，只需要聚焦。
lines.en: I need nothing but focus.
The closer you stand, the clearer you are.

lines.zh: 光聚在一起，就是我们的语言。
lines.en: Light gathered together is our language.
Come up to that height and I'll meet you.
I keep this stretch of sky.

lines.zh: 我不睡，所以夜里也看得见。
lines.en: I don't sleep, so I see at night too.

lines.zh: 你要留下，就站在我的中心线上。
lines.en: If you stay, stand on my centre line.

lines.zh: 我停下去看，靠近得很慢。
lines.en: I stop to look, approaching slowly.
This thing throws my light back.
I hold it up in the air.
I light it and see.
Too heavy for me to lift.
That light I'll take.

lines.zh: 我把它压在地上，慢慢看。
lines.en: I press it to the ground and study it.
What falls, I look at before moving on.
This thing has no light to it.
Enough. No need for more.
You've entered my centre.
I'm locked. I won't shift now.
My pupil has taken you in.
The light is gathering. You should move.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在我视野里跳动。
lines.en: Your heartbeat pulses in my sight.
One target is enough.
I rise two blocks to prepare.
Too open here. You can't hide.
I narrow my gaze.
I come head on, no detour.
You have seconds left.
This beam will be quick.
I come head on. No circling.
Your position: dead centre.
I've worked out the angle.

lines.zh: 我这只激光眼，先对准再说。
lines.en: My laser eye aims before anything else.

lines.zh: 我的外壳对准了你，转都转不动。
lines.en: My casing has turned to you and won't turn back.

lines.zh: 你身上那点热，我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: I see the heat on you perfectly clearly.

lines.zh: 我先把高度定死，再动手。
lines.en: I'll fix my altitude first, then move.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸节奏，我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized your breathing.
I hover still and the light grows.
You go left and my gaze follows.
From this eye, the laser arrives first.

lines.zh: 我的视线从上面压下来。
lines.en: My gaze bears down from above.
I measure how far off you still are.
I rise out of your reach.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我的角度就变一次。
lines.en: Each step you take changes my angle.

lines.zh: 光已经在瞳孔里成形了。
lines.en: The light has taken shape in my pupil.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，动作更难预测。
lines.en: When you run, you're harder to predict.
I close another half block.
Your shadow keeps pointing to you.
Only you on this open ground.

lines.zh: 我的光把周围都染白了。
lines.en: My light has bleached everything nearby.
Soon. Nearly upon you.
I'm waiting for your hand to drop.

lines.zh: 我绕了一点，避开你的正手。
lines.en: I shift a little off your forehand.

lines.zh: 你退到石头背后也没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind that stone won't help.

lines.zh: 我已经看见你的肩在动。
lines.en: I see your shoulder move.
Right. This one will be true.
I've hung above you the whole time.

lines.zh: 我射出一束光，正中你的胸口。
lines.en: I fire a beam square into your chest.

lines.zh: 这一束带着全部的蓄力。
lines.en: That beam carried all my charge.

lines.zh: 光从我的瞳孔里冲出来。
lines.en: The light bursts from my pupil.
I drop low and fire from close.
You raise your shield and the beam bursts on it.
A second beam follows.
My shots are slow, but true.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被烧出一道痕。
lines.en: Your armor takes a burned line.
That beam lands by your feet.
I pull back to recharge.

lines.zh: 光穿过你的袖子，留下焦边。
lines.en: The beam passes through your sleeve and leaves it charred.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，可惜我已经对准。
lines.en: You dodged, but I'm already lined up.

lines.zh: 这一束，是我攒了很久的。
lines.en: That beam I'd saved a long while.
Once more, and the placement will be better.
I open in midair. The light arrives first.

lines.zh: 外壳一层层校准，我成形了。
lines.en: My casing calibrates layer by layer and I take shape.
Open ground here. Room to hang.

lines.zh: 我的光把地面照白了一片。
lines.en: My light bleaches a patch of ground.
I rise slowly to find my altitude.
My pupil sweeps a full circle.

lines.zh: 周围没有别的东西在动。
lines.en: Nothing else is moving nearby.
I hang there, casing turning slowly.
This is my second phase.
My light draws into a single point.
I begin to charge. Slowly.
There's something living nearby.
I rise two blocks and look around.
Light spreads out before me.
I've brought my gaze to bear.
This is the second time I open my eye.
The air around me has grown hot.
Right. My eye is open.
I'm dead centre, facing you.
This won't take long.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，温度变了。
lines.en: Fire changes my casing's temperature.
I fall and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水一进外壳，我的光就散了。
lines.en: Water gets in and my light scatters.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得翻了一圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭打在我的外壳接缝上。
lines.en: An arrow hits a seam in my casing.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的光聚不起来。
lines.en: That force won't let my light gather.

lines.zh: 没有光可以吃，我越来越淡。
lines.en: No light to feed on. I keep dimming.
Lightning pours into my pupil.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我的光探不远。
lines.en: No air in the void. My light carries no distance.
